Nina R.: Partner (edge-hw SI) requested compliance packet for marketplace tile: SOC2 attestation, 1-page pentest exec summary, supply-chain questionnaire, HSM attestation. Procurement wants links by next Wed.

Cole H. (sec): We can assemble that. Redaction rules: strip IPs, hostnames, serials, customer IDs. CVE details -> public advisory link only.

Dana L. (legal): I need to review the attestation and questionnaire before signing. No promotional security claims in the cover letter.

Ravi S. (infra): Upload plan: originals -> s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/inbound/edge-hw/ ; redacted bundle -> /outbound/edge-hw/. Add README.md describing redactions.

Nina R.: Partner asked for presigned links TTL=14d. Is that acceptable?

Cole H. (sec): Fine for hardware partners. We'll require security signoff before presign. Also include sha256 checksum and integrity note.

Dana L. (legal): I'll sign the cover letter after Sec confirms redactions. Send drafts to legal@redwood.com.

Ravi S. (infra): Command I'll use to presign after signoff: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/edge-hw/compliance-package.zip --expires-in 1209600`

Nina R.: Timeline: originals in inbound by Mon EOD, redacted bundle Tue noon, sec review Tue afternoon, legal sign Wed morning, presign Wed afternoon, send to partner.

notif-bot: Reminder set: "Edge HW compliance packet due" on 2026-06-02 09:00.

Cole H. (sec): Uploaded draft redactions to inbound/redaction_notes.md. Please avoid raw exploit details.

Ravi S. (infra): Redacted bundle v1 created in outbound and sha256.txt included.

Dana L. (legal): Signed cover letter placed in outbound.

Nina R.: Presigned links created and shared with partner (TTL 14 days). Partner acknowledges receipt and requested tentative co-announcement window next quarter.

Cole H. (sec): Logging this flow as a template for future edge-hw partnerships.

Nina R.: Thanks all — closing thread unless any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
